blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Most image-based 3D reconstructors primarily recover visible surfaces, producing partial point clouds with large holes and leaving unobserved geometry unresolved. To address this limitation, we introduce AnchorComplete, a framework that reconstructs complete scene meshes from partial point clouds while preserving observed geometry and supporting scenes of varying scales. Building on TRELLIS.2, our method combines partial-point conditioning, which integrates global scene tokens with local spatial evidence to anchor generation to the input, and metric-scale coarse-to-fine generation, which progressively refines scene geometry within fixed-size windows while maintaining global structural consistency. Experiments on Replica and SCRREAM demonstrate that AnchorComplete consistently outperforms strong baselines in complete-scene reconstruction, particularly under sparse-view settings.
blocks.zh: 大多数基于图像的3D重建器主要回收可见地表,产生有大孔的部分点云并留下未观测到的几何问题未解决. 为解决这一局限性,我们引入了AnchorComplete,这个框架从部分点云重建完整的场景网,同时保留观测到的几何和不同尺度的支持场景. 在TRELLIS.2的基础上,我们的方法结合了部分点调,将全局场景符号与局部空间证据相融合,将生成物锁定在输入物上;并结合了公制尺度粗到细的生成物,在固定大小窗口内逐步完善场景几何,同时保持全球结构一致性. 关于复制品和SCREAM的实验表明,AnchorComplete在完全景地重建中,特别是在景地稀疏的环境下,其业绩始终超过强有力的基线。

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en:
We study the problem of recovering a complete 3D mesh of a scene given only a partial observation, such as the output of a 3D reconstructor or a 3D scanner.
A robust solution to this problem would benefit downstream applications such as novel-view AR/VR rendering ( Xie et al., 2026 ) , large-scale physical simulation ( Savva et al., 2019 ; Szot et al., 2021 ) , and robotics ( Liu et al., 2023a ) , where complete scene meshes are often required for rendering, collision detection, and physical interaction.
blocks.zh:
我们研究只进行部分观察,例如输出出一款三维重建器或一款三维扫描仪,以恢复一个场景的完整三维网格的问题。
解决这个问题的有力办法将有利于下游应用,如新颖视角的AR/VR渲染(Xie等,2026年),大规模物理模拟(Savva等,2019年;Szot等,2021年),机器人(Liu等,2023年a),其中渲染,相撞探测和物理交互经常需要完整的场景网.

blocks.en:
Addressing this problem requires tackling two coupled challenges:
(i) preserving fidelity to the observed geometry and
(ii) scaling completion to any physical scene size.
Recently, feed-forward 3D reconstructors like DUSt3R ( Wang et al., 2024 ) and its variants ( Leroy et al., 2024 ; Wang et al., 2025b ; Wang et al., 2025a ; Yang et al., 2025 ; Sun et al., 2024 ; Keetha et al., 2025 ; Wang et al., 2026 ) , as well as online SLAM systems like DROID-SLAM ( Teed & Deng, 2021 ) and VGGT-SLAM ( Maggio et al., 2025 ) , have made it possible to obtain dense point clouds of scenes in a single forward pass by scaling the model and training data to directly regress 3D points from image observations.
However, completion is not part of their formulation, so unobserved regions remain large holes,
limiting their applicability in many downstream applications.

Early completion methods ( Han et al., 2017 ; Lyu et al., 2021 ; Yu et al., 2021 ; Zhou et al., 2021 ) focus on completing point clouds of single objects in normalized coordinate spaces and thus do not scale to scene-level inputs.
While Amodal3R ( Wu et al., 2025 ) , SAM 3D ( Team et al., 2025 ) , ShapeR ( Siddiqui et al., 2026 ) ,
and CoLa3D ( Cai et al., 2026 ) extend foundational 3D generators ( Zhang et al., 2023 ; Zhang et al., 2024 ; Hunyuan3D et al., 2025a ; Xiang et al., 2024 ; Xiang et al., 2025 ; Li et al., 2025a ) to occluded geometry, they mainly address separate object completion in normalized coordinate spaces and do not directly condition on partial point observations, so they may not remain faithful to the geometry actually observed by the cameras.
Recent scene completion methods like PaSCo ( Cao et al., 2024 ) , NOVA3R ( Chen et al., 2026b ) , and Seen2Scene ( Meng et al., 2026 ) aim to generate complete scene geometry.
While promising, these models typically complete within the given field of view, without considering geometry outside the camera view.
They also do not output a complete mesh, but rather a point cloud or a voxel grid, which may not be directly usable for downstream applications.

近期的场景完成方法有"PaSCo"(Cao等,2024),"NOVA3R"(Chen等,2026b)等,"Seen2Scene"(Meng等,2026)旨在生成完整的场景几何.
这些模型虽然很有希望,但一般在给定的视野内完成,而不考虑相机视野外的几何特征.
它们也不输出完整的网格,而是点云或花纹网格,它们可能无法直接用于下游应用.

blocks.en:
Seeking to close this gap, we introduce AnchorComplete , a generative framework that takes as input a partial point cloud, such as one recovered from sparse RGB observations, and outputs a complete scene mesh ( Figure 1 ).
We build on the TRELLIS ( Xiang et al., 2024 ; Xiang et al., 2025 ) , but adapting it to scene completion poses two key challenges: faithfully preserving observed geometry and scaling to scenes of varying spatial extent. When an entire scene is normalized into a single cube, the physical size of each mesh cell increases with the scene extent.
blocks.zh:
为了缩小这一差距,我们引入了AnchorComplete, 以部分点云(例如从稀少的RGB观测中恢复出来的点云)作为输入的基因框架,并输出出完整的场景网(图1)。
我们以TRELLIS(Xiang等,2024;Xiang等,2025)为基础,但为了完成场景而加以调整,提出了两大挑战:忠实地保存所观测到的几何学并缩放到不同空间范围的场景. 当整个场景被正常化为单个立方体时,每个网格的物理大小会随场景范围而增加.

blocks.en: We address these challenges with two main components. Partial-point conditioning anchors generation to the input through a hybrid scheme that combines global cross-attention to transformer-encoded anchor tokens with local spatial injection of observed voxels into the noisy latent. Metric-scale coarse-to-fine generation covers the scene with an octree of fixed physical size windows, each refining its coarser parent, which keeps the layout consistent across windows while adding detail at any scene size. Together, they enable faithful and scalable scene completion from sparse observations.

blocks.en:
We evaluate our method on the Replica ( Straub et al., 2019 ) and SCRREAM ( Jung et al., 2024 ) datasets, where we reconstruct complete indoor scenes under standard and sparse-view settings.
Our experiments demonstrate that AnchorComplete recovers more complete scene geometry than the baselines while remaining faithful to the visible input, and degrades more slowly as camera coverage drops. Our contributions are: • We take a step towards recovering complete meshes of scenes from partial point clouds, without requiring densely sampled posed images, oriented normals, or per-scene optimization.
For this new problem setting, we formulate strong baselines and evaluation protocols. • We introduce AnchorComplete , a generative framework that contributes two architectural components: (1) partial-point conditioning and (2) metric-scale coarse-to-fine generation on an octree of fixed physical size windows, which decouples mesh resolution from scene extent; together they enable generative mesh completion at scene scale while remaining anchored to the observed reconstruction. • AnchorComplete achieves the best CD all \mathrm{CD}_{\mathrm{all}} and F-scores on Replica and SCRREAM, and degrades more slowly than the visible-surface baselines we evaluate as input views decrease.

我们的实验表明,AnchorComplete比基线恢复更完整的场景几何,同时忠于可见的输入,并随着相机覆盖的下降而更缓慢地降解. • 我们的贡献是: 我们迈出了一步,从部分点云中恢复完整的场景网格, 不需要大量取样的外观图像, 定向的常态, 或每个场景的优化。

blocks.en: 2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en:
DUSt3R ( Wang et al., 2024 ) and MASt3R ( Leroy et al., 2024 ) regress dense pixel-aligned point maps from unposed image collections, marking a shift toward generalizable, pose-free 3D reconstruction.
Building on this paradigm, several recent works ( Wang et al., 2025a ; Wang et al., 2025b ; Lin et al., 2025 ; Yang et al., 2025 ; Sun et al., 2024 ; Keetha et al., 2025 ; Wang et al., 2025c ; Chen et al., 2026a ; Wang et al., 2026 ) extend it to multi-view settings, while online dense SLAM systems ( Teed & Deng, 2021 ; Murai et al., 2025 ; Liu et al., 2025 ; Maggio et al., 2025 ) integrate such reconstruction into camera-trajectory estimation.
Surface fitters such as Poisson and Screened Poisson reconstruction ( Kazhdan et al., 2006 ; Kazhdan & Hoppe, 2013 ) , and learned methods such as NKSR and NoKSR ( Huang et al., 2023 ; Li et al., 2025b ) , convert oriented points into smooth implicit surfaces.
All remain tied to camera-visible geometry: occluded regions go unmodeled, and surfaces fitted across holes follow smoothness rather than any prior over the unobserved scene. We instead complete those regions with a learned generative prior.
blocks.zh:
DUST3R (Wang等, 2024年)和MAST3R (Leroy等, 2024年) 从无位图像集中递减了密集像素相通点地图,标志着向通俗化,无姿势3D重建的转变.
在这个范式的基础上,最近的一些作品(Wang等,2025a;Wang等,2025b;Lin等,2025;Yang等,2025;Sun等,2024;Keetha等,2025;Wang等,2025c;Chen等,2026a;Wang等,2026)将其扩展至多景环境,而在线密集的SLAM系统则扩展至多景环境. (Teed & Deng, 2021; Murai等, 2025;Liu等, 2025;Maggio等, 2025) 将这种重建纳入相机-弹道估计。
Pouisson和Screened Pouisson等地的配器(Kazhdan等,2006年;Kazhdan等,2013年;Kazhdan等,2013年;NKSR和NoKSR等所学方法(Huang等,2023年;Li等,2025年b)),将取向点转换为平滑隐含地表.
都与相机可见的几何相接:被遮住的区域没有建模,穿孔相接的地表遵循平滑,而不是任何在被遮住的场景之前。 相反,我们在完成这些地区之前就已经学会了遗传学。

blocks.en:
Generative 3D methods synthesize complete geometry from images, text, layouts, or latent representations. Image-space methods such as Text2Room ( Höllein et al., 2023 ) , Invisible Stitch ( Engstler et al., 2025 ) , and GenRC ( Li et al., 2024 ) iteratively inpaint and lift RGB-D views, while foundation 3D generators ( Zhang et al., 2023 ; Zhang et al., 2024 ; Xiang et al., 2024 ; Hunyuan3D et al., 2025a ; Li et al., 2025a ; Xiang et al., 2025 ) and amodal methods ( Wu et al., 2025 ; Team et al., 2025 ; Siddiqui et al., 2026 ) recover complete object geometry from image or text prompts.
Scene-scale approaches ( Shriram et al., 2025 ; Wu et al., 2024 ; Ju et al., 2024 ; Roessle et al., 2024 ; Bahmani et al., 2023 ; Yang et al., 2024a ; Yang et al., 2024b ; Feng et al., 2023 ) generate rooms from learned scene representations or layouts.
However, these priors are not directly constrained by the metric geometry of a specific partial reconstruction, motivating our point-conditioned formulation.
blocks.zh:
基因3D方法从图像,文字,布局,或潜伏的表示合成完整的几何. Text2Room(Höllein等,2023年),Invisible Stitch(Engstler等,2025年)和GenRC(Li等,2024年)等图像空间方法迭代地印出并提升了RGB-D视角,而地基3D发电机(Zhang等,2023年;Zhang等,2024年;Xiang等,2024年;Hunyuan3D等,2025a;Li等,2025a;Xiang等,2025年)和模式方法(Wu等,2025年;Team等,2025年;Siddiqui等,2026年)从图像或文字提示中恢复完整的物体几何.
场景尺度办法 (Shriram等,2025年;Wu等,2024年;Ju等,2024年;Roessle等,2024年;Bahmani等,2023年;Yang等,2024年a;Yang等,2024年b;Feng等,2023年b)从学习的场景表现或布局产生房间.
然而,这些前科并不直接受到具体部分重建的几何特征的制约,这促使我们有针对性地制定。

blocks.en:
Completion methods condition on partial 3D input to infer missing geometry. Object-centric approaches ( Yuan et al., 2018 ; Yu et al., 2021 ; Zhou et al., 2022 ; Chu et al., 2023 ; Han et al., 2017 ; Lyu et al., 2021 ; Zhou et al., 2021 ) complete point clouds or shapes, while scene methods ( Dai et al., 2018 ; Dai et al., 2020 ) predict occupancy or SDFs from partial voxel grids, typically at limited resolution.
More recent generative models such as Hunyuan3D-Omni ( Hunyuan3D et al., 2025b ) and ShapeR ( Siddiqui et al., 2026 ) condition foundation 3D generators on partial geometry but remain object-scale.
At scene scale, PaSCo ( Cao et al., 2024 ) , NOVA3R ( Chen et al., 2026b ) , Points-to-3D ( Xia et al., 2026b ) , Seen2Scene ( Meng et al., 2026 ) , GenRecon ( Schmid et al., 2026 ) and Surflo ( Guédon et al., 2026 ) explore occupancy, amodal reconstruction, latent generation, or chunk-based completion.
Seen2Scene is the closest baseline to our setting.
Maintaining fidelity to observed geometry while plausibly completing missing regions remains a central challenge in scene completion. We condition a pretrained 3D generative prior on a raw scene-scale partial reconstruction and output a completed mesh in the original scene coordinate frame ( Section 3 ).
blocks.zh:
完成方法条件以部分3D输入来推断缺失几何. 以物体为中心的方法(袁克等,2018;于克等,2021;周克等,2022;朱克等,2023;韩克等,2017;柳克等,2021;周克等,2021;)完整点云或形状,而场景方法(戴克等,2018;戴克等,2020;)预测占用率或SDF来自部分花纹网格,一般分辨率有限.
更相近的基因模型,如Hunyuan3D-Omni(Hunyuan3D等,2025b)和ShapeR(Siddiqui等,2026)在部分几何学上将3D基相发生器作为条件,但仍为对象尺度.
在现场尺度上,PaSCo(Cao等,2024年),NOVA3R(Chen等,2026年b),Point-to-3D(Xia等,2026年b),Seen2Scene(Meng等,2026年),GenRecon (Schmid等,2026年)和Surflo(Guédon等,2026年)探索入住,模式重建,潜在生成,或以块为单位完成.
Seven2Scene是距离我们设定最近的基线.
保持对所观测到几何的忠诚,同时合理完成缺失区域,仍然是完成现场工作的主要挑战。 在原始场景规模部分重建之前,我们先对3D基因进行预修,并在原场景坐标框中输出完成的网格(第3节)。

blocks.en: 3 Method
blocks.zh: 3 方法

blocks.en: Figure 2: Overview of AnchorComplete . From a partial, colored point cloud, Stage 1 generates a metric-scale octree coarse to fine, one window at a time, and Stage 2 generates shape latents on the finest level, which are decoded, merged and meshed once. Each window is conditioned on its parent occupancy and visible points through the local path (warm start) and on its points through anchor tokens read by cross-attention (global path).
blocks.zh: 图2:Anchorcomplete概览 从局部的有色点云,第一阶段产生一公尺大小的八角形粗糙到细细,一次一个窗口,第二阶段产生出最优水平的外形潜伏物,这些潜伏物被解码,并被合并并被冰封一次. 每个窗口都以母窗口占用和通过本地路径(温起站点)可见点为条件,并取用通过交叉意向(全球路径)读取的锚地标志来显示点.

blocks.en:
We develop AnchorComplete , a generative model that recovers a complete scene mesh ℳ \mathcal{M} from a partial point cloud 𝒫 \mathcal{P} obtained from feed-forward 3D reconstruction ( Wang et al., 2025a ; Lin et al., 2025 ) , SLAM ( Teed & Deng, 2021 ; Maggio et al., 2025 ) , or 3D scanning ( Dai et al., 2017 ) .
The key challenge is to hallucinate plausible geometry in unobserved regions while preserving the observed structure.
Our model, illustrated in Figure 2 , builds on TRELLIS.2 ( Xiang et al., 2025 ) and adapts it to scene-level completion through partial-point conditioning and metric-scale coarse-to-fine generation.
We first review TRELLIS in Section 3.1 , then present partial-point conditioning in Section 3.2 and the coarse-to-fine octree that extends the generator from a single normalized cube to metric scale in Section 3.3 , followed by training details in Section 3.4 .
blocks.zh:
我们开发了 AnchorComplete,一种基因模型,从部分点云 P\mathcal{M}中恢复一个完整的场景 mesh M\mathcal{M} 从饲料向前的3D重建(Wang等人,2025a;Lin等人,2025年),SLAM(Teed & Deng,2021年;Maggio等人,2025年),或3D扫描(Dai等人,2017年).
关键的挑战在于在未观测到的地区幻出可能存在的几何特征,同时保留所观测到的结构。
我们的模式以TRELLIS.2(Xiang等,2025年)为基础,通过局部点整和公尺粗到细的生成来适应场景级的完成。
我们首先在第3.1节中审查TRELLIS,然后在第3.2节中提出部分点值,然后在第3.3节中提出将发电机从一个普通立方体延伸至度量尺度的粗到细辛八树,然后在第3.4节中提出培训细节。

blocks.en: 3.1 Preliminaries: TRELLIS
blocks.zh: 3.1 初步情况: 纹身

blocks.en:
TRELLIS ( Xiang et al., 2024 ) is a foundational 3D asset generator that takes a text prompt or image as the condition 𝐜 \mathbf{c} and outputs various 3D representations,
including meshes ℳ \mathcal{M} ,
Gaussian splats 𝒢 \mathcal{G} ,
and radiance fields ℛ \mathcal{R} .
For flexibility, TRELLIS represents the given 3D asset 𝒪 \mathcal{O} with a set of Structured Latents (SLATs) 𝒵 = { 𝒛 i , 𝒑 i } i = 1 L \mathcal{Z}=\{\bm{z}_{i},\bm{p}_{i}\}_{i=1}^{L} on a predefined H × W × D H\times W\times D spatial grid Ω \Omega , where L ≪ H ​ W ​ D L\ll HWD is the number of active voxels, 𝒑 i ∈ ℝ 3 \bm{p}_{i}\in\mathbb{R}^{3} is the 3D coordinate of the i i -th active voxel, and 𝒛 i ∈ ℝ C \bm{z}_{i}\in\mathbb{R}^{C} is the corresponding latent feature encoding local geometry and appearance information.

包括 meshes M\ mathcal{M}, ,

During generation, a flow transformer 𝒯 s \mathcal{T}_{\text{s}} first generates the structure latent 𝒛 s \bm{z}_{\text{s}} from Gaussian noise conditioned on text or image tokens 𝐜 \mathbf{c} .
The sampled latent is decoded into the active voxel support { 𝒑 i } i = 1 L \{\bm{p}_{i}\}_{i=1}^{L} , which determines the coarse spatial layout.

blocks.en:
Global Anchor Tokens. We design a simple architecture to extract anchor tokens from the input point observations 𝒫 = { 𝒑 i } i = 1 N \mathcal{P}=\{\bm{p}_{i}\}_{i=1}^{N} .
In particular, we implement the point-cloud encoder ℰ p \mathcal{E}_{\text{p}} using a transformer architecture inspired by the point encoder of NOVA3R ( Chen et al., 2026b ) , but with its per-point features taken from a pretrained Utonia backbone ( Zhang et al., 2026 ) .
To this end, we first extract high-dimensional features { 𝒇 i } i = 1 N \{\bm{f}_{i}\}_{i=1}^{N} for all N N input points with the frozen Utonia backbone.
The encoder then uses m m learnable queries ℱ q \mathcal{F}^{q} and the full set of point features ℱ ( k , v ) = { 𝒇 i } i = 1 N \mathcal{F}^{(k,v)}=\{\bm{f}_{i}\}_{i=1}^{N} as the keys and values for the encoder’s cross-attention layers, where m ≪ N m\ll N is a fixed number of point tokens.
The anchor tokens are further refined by several interleaved self-attention and cross-attention blocks.
The resulting anchor tokens 𝒄 p ∈ ℝ m × C xa \bm{c}_{\text{p}}\in\mathbb{R}^{m\times C_{\text{xa}}} , where C xa C_{\text{xa}} is the cross-attention feature dimension, are then fed to the TRELLIS.2 flow model as global conditioning tokens through cross-attention, replacing the original image/text conditioning tokens in both stages.
We use m = 768 m=768 anchor tokens. The encoder also reads the point colours and, in the metric-scale model of Section 3.3 , two per-point attributes: an observed-point flag and the expected depth-noise level.

Local Spatial Injection. To further encourage spatial consistency between the generated geometry and the input point cloud, we introduce a local spatial conditioning path that injects visible-point evidence directly into the first-stage structure latent space.
Inspired by condition injection strategies in image editing ( Avrahami et al., 2023 ) , we first voxelize the point observations 𝒫 \mathcal{P} into a binary 3D grid 𝑶 vis ∈ { 0 , 1 } H × W × D \bm{O}_{\mathrm{vis}}\in\{0,1\}^{H\times W\times D} , setting a voxel to 1 if it contains at least one observed point and to 0 otherwise.
It is then encoded with the pretrained structure encoder ℰ s \mathcal{E}_{\text{s}} to obtain partial-geometry features 𝒛 vis ∈ ℝ H s × W s × D s × C \bm{z}_{\mathrm{vis}}\in\mathbb{R}^{\frac{H}{s}\times\frac{W}{s}\times\frac{D}{s}\times C} .
In parallel, we downsample 𝑶 vis \bm{O}_{\mathrm{vis}} to obtain a 3D binary mask 𝑶 vis , m ∈ { 0 , 1 } H s × W s × D s \bm{O}_{\mathrm{vis},m}\in\{0,1\}^{\frac{H}{s}\times\frac{W}{s}\times\frac{D}{s}} , indicating which latent cells correspond to visible regions.
The visible evidence enters Stage 1 in two ways.
First, it initializes the flow: rather than starting from Gaussian noise everywhere, we replace the initial sample at visible cells by 𝒛 vis \bm{z}_{\mathrm{vis}} , 𝒛 s ( 1 ) = 𝑶 vis , m ⊙ 𝒛 vis + ( 𝟏 − 𝑶 vis , m ) ⊙ ϵ , ϵ ∼ 𝒩 ⁡ ( 𝟎 , 𝑰 ) , \bm{z}_{s}^{(1)}\;=\;\bm{O}_{\mathrm{vis},m}\odot\bm{z}_{\mathrm{vis}}\;+\;(\mathbf{1}-\bm{O}_{\mathrm{vis},m})\odot\bm{\epsilon},\qquad\bm{\epsilon}\sim\mathcal{N}(\mathbf{0},\bm{I}), (1) where 𝒛 s ( 1 ) \bm{z}_{s}^{(1)} is the latent the sampler starts from.
Second, the mask is available at every denoising step: we concatenate 𝑶 vis , m \bm{O}_{\mathrm{vis},m} to the noisy latent and feed the result back to the denoiser, so it can separate observed from unobserved cells throughout sampling.
Stage 2 uses both as well: it receives 𝒛 vis \bm{z}_{\mathrm{vis}} , read at its voxels, with a per-voxel visibility flag at every denoising step, and its initial sample takes, on observed voxels, the shape latents encoded from the visible points.

blocks.en: 3.3 Metric-Scale Coarse-to-Fine Generation
blocks.zh: 3.3 粗到精代计量尺度

blocks.en:
A single normalized cube is stretched to fit the whole input, so its cells grow with the scene. In a small room this hardly matters, but in a large apartment each cell ends up several centimetres wide and thin parts such as chair legs or shelf boards disappear. A finer cube does not help either, since a resolution that suits the apartment is wasted on a bathroom.
We therefore stop tying the cell size to the scene and generate it coarse to fine.
blocks.zh:
一个单一的正态立方体被拉伸来配合整个输入,因此它的细胞会随场景而生长. 在一间小房间里,这不重要,但是在一个大的公寓里,每间牢房最终会长出几厘米宽而细的部位,如椅子腿或架板等都消失了. 更精细的立方体也无济于事,因为适合公寓的解决方案被浪费在了浴室上.
因此,我们停止把细胞大小绑在现场,并产生粗糙到精细.

blocks.en:
Multi-Levels. Level 0 is the single cube itself: it sees the whole scene at once and gives the overall layout of the rooms, even if the details are rough.
Levels 1 and 2 then cover the occupied space with windows of a fixed physical size, the level-2 windows half as wide as the level-1 windows, so each level’s 512 3 512^{3} mesh grid has a fixed cell size regardless of scene size, and further levels 3 , 4 , … 3,4,\dots would halve the window again; Figure 3 shows what each level resolves. In observed regions, the window follows the input geometry; in unobserved regions, it is initialized from the parent prediction and primarily refines that prediction rather than synthesizing a new layout.
Inside a window, both stages of Section 3.2 run unchanged on the window’s crop of the input; the model never needs to know how large the scene is. All levels use the sparse-structure and O-Voxel latents of TRELLIS.2 ( Xiang et al., 2025 ) .

blocks.en: 4.1 Experimental Setup

blocks.en:
Evaluation datasets. We evaluate on two indoor datasets with ground-truth geometry for both visible and occluded regions: Replica ( Straub et al., 2019 ) with 8 photorealistic indoor reconstructions with high-quality meshes and densely sampled trajectories, and SCRREAM ( Jung et al., 2024 ) with 12 real-world captures with accurate per-scene ground truth, which we treat as our primary real-world benchmark.
Note that, we do not use any of the training scenes from these datasets.
blocks.zh:
评价数据集。 我们评价了两套室内数据集,其中地貌几何,既包括可见区域,也包括被渗透区域: 复制品 (Straub等, 2019年) 有8个光现实主义室内重建,具有高品质的网格和高采样轨迹; SCREAM (Jung等, 2024年) 有12个真实世界捕捉器,准确的每地真象,我们将其作为我们的首要真实世界基准.
请注意,我们不使用这些数据集的任何训练场景。

blocks.en: Training data construction. We train AnchorComplete on InternScenes ( Zhong et al., 2025 ) and SAGE ( Xia et al., 2026a ) . We use around 16 ​ k 16\text{k} scenes from InternScenes, whose watertight glTF meshes serve as complete supervision ℳ \mathcal{M} , and around 7 ​ k 7\text{k} rooms from SAGE, whose complete meshes are used the same way; both cover observed surfaces and occluded regions. Per scene we render multi-view RGB-D (InternScenes with BlenderProc ( Denninger et al., 2023 ) ) at 640 × 480 640{\times}480 and an 85 ∘ 85^{\circ} horizontal field of view, placing cameras with an area-adaptive multi-anchor sampler plus corner viewpoints for coverage. Details are in the appendix.
blocks.zh: 培训数据建设. 我们通过实习人员(钟等,2025年)和SAGE(夏等,2026年a)培训AnchorComplete。 我们使用来自 InternScenes 的 16 k 16\text{k} 的场景,这些场景的防水glTF meshes 充当了完全的监管 M\mathcal{M} , 以及来自 SAGE 的 7 k 7\text{k} 房间, 其完整的 meshes 被同样使用; 既覆盖了观测到的表面,又覆盖了所覆盖的区域. 每个场景,我们制造多视图的RGB-D(InternScens with BlenderProc (Denninger et al., 2023)) 在640 × 480 640\times}480 和一个85\ 85\circ}的横向视场上,放置相机,配有区域适应多角度的多角度采样器和角角度的覆盖. 详情见附录。

blocks.en:
Metrics. Following prior work ( Wang et al., 2024 ; Wang et al., 2025a ; Chen et al., 2026b ; Guédon et al., 2026 ) , we report Chamfer Distance (CD) and F-score, using ground-truth poses to crop the visible mesh within the input view frustums. We decompose CD into accuracy (prediction-to-GT) and completeness (GT-to-prediction). CD vis \mathrm{CD}_{\mathrm{vis}} is symmetric over the visible region, while CD all \mathrm{CD}_{\mathrm{all}} combines visible-region accuracy with full-scene completeness. F-scores at 0.1 0.1 and 0.05 ​ m 0.05\,\mathrm{m} use the same regions as CD all \mathrm{CD}_{\mathrm{all}} ; lower CD and higher F are better.
Accuracy is computed only for predictions inside the input-view frustums, since completion outside the observed region is inherently multi-modal and the ground truth represents only one valid realization.
See Section A.2 for details.

准确性的计算只针对输入-视图frustums内部的预测,因为观测区域以外的完成本质上是多模式的,地面真理只是一种有效的实现。
详情见A.2节。

We compare against three groups, grouped as in Table 1 . i) Feed-forward dense reconstruction : VGGT- Ω \Omega ( Wang et al., 2026 ) , DA3 ( Lin et al., 2025 ) , CUT3R ( Wang et al., 2025b ) , and PI-3 ( Wang et al., 2025c ) predict dense geometry from images but target visible surfaces only; none outputs a mesh, so we convert all of them with the same pipeline. ii) Image-based generation : TRELLIS ( Xiang et al., 2024 ) , GenRC ( Li et al., 2024 ) and Surflo ( Guédon et al., 2026 ) test whether generative priors alone recover missing geometry. iii) Scene completion : SG-NN ( Dai et al., 2020 ) , NKSR ( Huang et al., 2023 ) , and Seen2Scene ( Meng et al., 2026 ) take partial point clouds and predict complete surfaces, matching our input-output setting most closely. blocks.en:
Implementation details. We initialize both stages of AnchorComplete from the TRELLIS.2 ( Xiang et al., 2025 ) image-to-3D checkpoints. The point-cloud encoder ℰ p \mathcal{E}_{\text{p}} keeps the Utonia backbone ( Zhang et al., 2026 ) frozen; only the four-layer Q-Former that turns its features into the m = 768 m{=}768 anchor tokens is trained. Both denoisers are 30-block DiTs with 1536 channels, 12 attention heads and rotary position embeddings. Stage 1 operates on the 8-channel 16 3 16^{3} sparse-structure latent, which is decoded into a 64 3 64^{3} occupancy grid and max-pooled to the 32 3 32^{3} support of Stage 2; Stage 2 generates the 32-channel O-Voxel latent on that support, from which the mesh is extracted on a 512 3 512^{3} grid.
Both stages are trained independently using AdamW with learning rate 2 × 10 − 5 2{\times}10^{-5} , weight decay 0.01 0.01 , batch size 1 per GPU and 10 % 10\% condition dropout, each fine-tuned for 40k steps on four NVIDIA L40 GPUs.
At inference each stage takes 12 flow steps. Additional details are provided in the appendix.

blocks.en:
Table 1 evaluates complete-scene reconstruction at N views = 4 N_{\mathrm{views}}{=}4 . AnchorComplete leads the complete-region metrics on both datasets against every baseline. On the visible region DA3 ( Lin et al., 2025 ) obtains the best CD vis \mathrm{CD}_{\mathrm{vis}} with AnchorComplete close behind, so the completion gains do not cost visible-surface fidelity; CUT3R ( Wang et al., 2025b ) struggles even there, likely because four views give little coverage of a full room.
Surflo ( Guédon et al., 2026 ) can generate complete meshes, but it still lags behind AnchorComplete by a wide margin, likely because it is trained mainly on object-centric data.
Surface fitting such as NKSR ( Huang et al., 2023 ) smooths visible points into surfaces but still lags, showing smoothing alone cannot recover unseen geometry, while TRELLIS ( Xiang et al., 2024 ) without partial-point conditioning drifts off the captured scene.
TRELLIS ∗ , our scene-level fine-tuned version of the same prior, improves substantially over the released object model but still trails AnchorComplete by a wide margin on both datasets, indicating that our advantage comes from conditioning on the observed geometry rather than from scene-level training.

AnchorComplete leads CD all \mathrm{CD}_{\mathrm{all}} and the F-scores at every view count we test, against DA3, NKSR and Surflo, with the largest gains in the sparsest setting: the gap to NKSR in CD all \mathrm{CD}_{\mathrm{all}} is widest at N = 2 N{=}2 on both datasets. blocks.en: 4.4 Ablation Study
blocks.zh: 4.4 读取研究

blocks.en: We ablate on Replica ( Straub et al., 2019 ) to analyze the contributions of key design choices in AnchorComplete .
blocks.zh: 我们放弃了复制品(Straub等人,2019年)来分析AnchorComplete中关键设计选择的贡献.

blocks.en: Importance of Partial-point Conditioning. Partial-point conditioning anchors the generative prior through two complementary paths ( Section 3.2 ), ablated in Table 2 (a): global anchor tokens , encoded from the input cloud and read via cross-attention, and local spatial injection , which injects the visible cloud into the structure latent. Removing local injection causes the largest drop, especially in visible-region fidelity ( CD vis \mathrm{CD}_{\mathrm{vis}} ), since per-voxel evidence localizes the observed geometry. Removing global anchor tokens causes a smaller drop, as the tokens supply scene-level context rather than localization.
blocks.zh: 部分点条件的重要性。 部分点位调节通过两个互补路径(第3.2节)将先入为主,在表2(a)中缩放:全球锚标,从输入云中编码并通过交叉意念读取,局部空间注入将可见云注入结构潜入. 移除局部注射会导致最大下降,特别是在可见区域忠心度(CD at\mathrm{ CD}_{\- mathrm{ vis}}),因为每伏克索尔证据使所观测到的几何学本地化. 移除全球锚地令牌会造成更小的下降,因为令牌提供场景级上下文而不是本地化.

blocks.en: Coarse-to-Fine Levels. Table 2 (b) and Figure 3 evaluate the pipeline after levels 0, 1, and 2 on five held-out real-world scenes and one Matterport3D house. Each finer level halves the mesh-cell size and recovers more geometric detail, substantially improving both the overall and high-curvature F-scores while reducing the accuracy error.

blocks.en: Robustness to Imperfect Inputs. All results above condition on raw DA3 clouds without confidence filtering. We additionally perturb the inputs without retraining ( Figure 8 ). blocks.en: 5 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 5 结论

blocks.en: We presented AnchorComplete , a generative framework for recovering complete scene meshes from partial point clouds. Our approach combines partial-point conditioning with metric-scale coarse-to-fine generation on an octree of fixed-size windows, which keeps the mesh resolution fixed in metres regardless of scene extent and generates complete scene geometry directly in the original scene coordinate frame. AnchorComplete improves complete-scene reconstruction over the baselines while maintaining high fidelity to the observed geometry. We further demonstrate robustness to sparse-view inputs and strong performance on real-world scenes, highlighting its potential for applications that require complete digital representations of physical environments.
blocks.zh: 我们提出了AnchorComplete, 一个从部分点云中恢复完整场景的基因框架。 我们的方法在固定大小窗口的八角树上结合了部分分点调节和公尺粗到细的生成,无论场景范围如何,将网格分辨率固定为米,直接在原场景坐标框中产生完整的场景几何. AnchorComplete改进了基线上的全场重建,同时保持了对所观测到几何高度的忠诚. 我们进一步表明,在现实世界的场景中,我们大量投入和强劲的表现,突出了其应用潜力,这些应用需要完整的物理环境数字化表述。

blocks.en: The experiments above condition on point clouds produced by DA3 ( Lin et al., 2025 ) , a per-view point-map estimator. Because AnchorComplete conditions directly on points rather than on images or estimator-specific features, it is not architecturally tied to this source. To test this, we apply AnchorComplete , with no retraining or source-specific tuning, to partial point clouds from four acquisition paradigms: learned per-view point maps (DA3, Pi3 ( Wang et al., 2025c ) , VGGT- Ω \Omega ( Wang et al., 2026 ) ), classical structure-from-motion and multi-view stereo (COLMAP ( Schönberger & Frahm, 2016 ) ), monocular visual SLAM (DROID-SLAM ( Teed & Deng, 2021 ) , DPVO ( Teed et al., 2022 ) ), and a simulated 32-beam LiDAR scan. All inputs are registered into the same evaluation frame and scored with the protocol used for the default DA3 setting.

blocks.en: A.6 Limitations
blocks.zh: A.6 限制

blocks.en: While AnchorComplete is robust to sparse input views ( Section 4.3 ), it still has several limitations. First, the current model predicts geometry only: we use the inherited mesh decoder and do not model appearance. Extending the framework with RGB supervision and an appearance-aware decoder could enable textured mesh generation. Second, performance depends on the quality of the upstream geometry, so drift, scale errors, or systematic depth bias may propagate to the generated mesh. Section A.5 shows the sharper form of this: severe upstream failures are inherited rather than corrected. Third, our training and evaluation focus on indoor scenes, and generalization to outdoor, unbounded, or substantially different scene distributions remains open.
blocks.zh: AnchorConflete虽然很强势,但很少输入(第4.3节),但仍有一些局限性。 首先,目前的模型只预测几何:我们使用所继承的网格解码器,而不使用模型外观. 在RGB的监督下扩展框架,以及一个外观知觉的解码器,可以使有文字的网格生成成为可能. 其次,性能取决于上游几何的质量,因此漂移,尺度误差,或系统深度偏差可能传播到生成的网格上. A.5节显示了更尖锐的形式:严重的上游失败是继承而不是纠正。 第三,我们的培训和评价侧重于室内场景,对室外、无限制或大相径庭的场景分布仍然开放。
